narration.text: Mortgage insurance taken off as soon as the law allows, on the household's loan and a parent's. This is a chore for a homeowner who bought in 2021 with 5 percent down, has been paying extra principal since 2024, and handles her widowed mother's mortgage under a power of attorney. Athena works it across 4 portals: Northgate Servicing, Ledgerline, Deedvault and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 3 of 3 eligible items, worth 2,732 dollars of the 2,732 dollars there was to find. All 3 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 33 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
